summary: Fazio, as CT State Senator, published a column titled 'Never Again Still Means Never Again' emphasizing October 7 attacks and solidarity with Israeli people in his district.
quote: The stories and images of the terrorist attacks against Israeli civilians on October 7th have broken hearts all over the world but especially in our area. In our community, and across the district I represent, the outpouring of support and solidarity for the Israeli people in their moment of tragedy
